The institutional investor held 21,200 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.16M, down from 29,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guinness Atkinson Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Conocophillips for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $76.37B market cap company.
